赋能.definition: To give someone the power, authority, or ability to do something
赋能.implication: In corporate contexts, often used to delegate responsibility while maintaining control; implies trust but with underlying power dynamics

破局.definition: To break a stalemate or find a new way to solve a problem
破局.implication: Suggests the current situation is stuck and requires bold, innovative thinking to overcome barriers

反思.definition: To think critically about past actions, decisions, or outcomes
反思.implication: Acknowledges shortcomings and demonstrates humility and willingness to improve

链路.definition: A connected pathway through various stages or nodes
链路.implication: Emphasizes process flows and data pipelines

颗粒度.definition: The level of detail or fineness in dividing units or analysis
颗粒度.implication: Fine granularity means more detailed and precise control

迭代.definition: To repeat or cycle through a process for progressive improvement
迭代.implication: Reflects continuous improvement and feedback loops

快速迭代.definition: Multiple improvements or updates to a product made in quick succession
快速迭代.implication: Reflects agile culture and learning mindset; core competitive advantage

优化.definition: To make something better, more efficient, or more effective
优化.implication: Suggests improvement is incremental rather than transformative

数字化.definition: Converting analog or physical processes into digital forms
数字化.implication: Represents modernization and automation of business

智能化.definition: Using AI to enable systems to learn and automate capabilities
智能化.implication: Represents technological progress and efficiency gains

内卷.definition: Intensifying competition within a fixed system where everyone works harder but no one gets ahead
内卷.implication: Describes the rat-race culture in Chinese education and workplaces where relentless effort yields diminishing returns; often used with resignation or bitter humor

躺平.definition: To reject societal pressure by doing the bare minimum — low consumption, low ambition, low effort
躺平.implication: A generational counter-culture response to 内卷; implies opting out of the competition rather than fighting a rigged game

破防.definition: To have one's emotional defenses broken; to be suddenly moved or upset by something
破防.implication: Used when something unexpectedly hits you hard emotionally — can be sadness, nostalgia, or rage; implies you couldn't keep your cool

凡尔赛.definition: Subtly showing off wealth or status while pretending to complain or be modest
凡尔赛.implication: Named after the Palace of Versailles; ridicules people who fish for compliments through disguised boasting; carries strong sarcasm

抽象.definition: Describing behavior or content that is bizarre, surreal, or out-of-left-field
抽象.implication: Internet slang for content that defies normal logic; often used approvingly for absurdist humor or live-stream chaos

典中典.definition: The most representative, textbook example of a particular type of person or situation
典中典.implication: Ironic admiration — calling something or someone so stereotypically typical that it's almost legendary; often used sarcastically

有点东西.definition: Said of someone or something that shows unexpected skill, depth, or quality
有点东西.implication: A compliment meaning the person or work surpassed expectations; implies pleasant surprise

摆烂.definition: To stop trying and let things deteriorate, giving up on maintaining standards
摆烂.implication: More extreme than 躺平; implies actively abandoning effort after a breaking point; used both seriously and humorously

绝绝子.definition: An emphatic slang term expressing that something is incredible, perfect, or top-tier
绝绝子.implication: Enthusiastic Gen-Z praise; the suffix '-子' adds a cute, informal tone; used for food, people, fashion, moments

yyds.definition: Abbreviation of 永远的神 (forever a god); the highest form of praise
yyds.implication: Internet slang equivalent of 'GOAT' (Greatest Of All Time); used for idols, games, food, or anything considered peerless

emo.definition: Feeling melancholic, sad, or emotionally drained without a specific reason
emo.implication: Borrowed from English subculture; in Chinese internet use it means a vague sense of sadness or existential gloom, often used casually

佛系.definition: A laid-back attitude of not striving for outcomes, accepting whatever happens
佛系.implication: Borrows Buddhist imagery of detachment; can be genuine contentment or quiet resignation; contrasts with the 卷 culture

鸡娃.definition: Aggressively pushing children into endless extracurricular activities and academic competitions
鸡娃.implication: Reflects intense anxiety among Chinese middle-class parents about education; the child is the 'chicken' being 'injected' with adrenaline

海王.definition: Someone who simultaneously maintains romantic ambiguity with many people, keeping all options open
海王.implication: Like Aquaman ruling the sea, this person has everyone on the hook; implies emotional manipulation and lack of commitment

绿茶.definition: A woman who appears innocent, gentle, and harmless but is scheming and manipulative underneath
绿茶.implication: Green tea is pure and clean on the surface; the term exposes the gap between appearance and intent; similar to 'two-faced'

白莲花.definition: Someone who projects an image of purity and innocence while secretly being calculating or malicious
白莲花.implication: The lotus grows from mud but appears pristine; used to call out people who play victim or act saintly for social gain

舔狗.definition: Someone who fawns excessively over a romantic interest, accepting mistreatment with no self-respect
舔狗.implication: Literally 'licking dog'; implies total submission and loss of dignity; used to mock or self-deprecate about unrequited infatuation

渣男.definition: A man who plays with multiple women's feelings, cheats, or behaves dishonestly in relationships
渣男.implication: Carries strong moral condemnation; implies the person knowingly exploits emotional vulnerability

渣女.definition: A woman who manipulates or cheats in relationships without regard for others' feelings
渣女.implication: Female counterpart to 渣男; equally condemning; used when a woman strings people along or plays emotional games

杠精.definition: Someone who reflexively argues against any statement, regardless of its merit
杠精.implication: Not just disagreeing but being combative for its own sake; implies the person has no real point, just loves to argue

键盘侠.definition: Someone who acts brave, righteous, or aggressive online but is passive in real life
键盘侠.implication: Mockingly highlights the cowardice behind online bravado; implies the person would never say or do these things face-to-face

喷子.definition: Someone who aggressively insults or attacks others online with little provocation
喷子.implication: More hostile than 键盘侠; implies someone who exists primarily to spray negativity; contributes nothing constructive

网暴.definition: Coordinated online harassment targeting an individual, often causing serious psychological harm
网暴.implication: A serious social issue in China; mob mentality fueled by algorithms; victims have faced mental breakdown or worse

吃瓜.definition: To be an entertained bystander watching a juicy conflict or scandal unfold
吃瓜.implication: Like eating a slice of watermelon while watching a show; implies detached amusement rather than involvement; internet culture spectator sport

瓜.definition: A piece of juicy gossip, scandal, or dramatic news
瓜.implication: Short for 吃瓜; calling news '瓜' signals it's entertaining drama worth spreading, not serious journalism

带节奏.definition: To manipulate public opinion by strategically framing information to provoke emotional reactions
带节奏.implication: Used to accuse someone of astroturfing or agitation; implies the person is not sharing facts but engineering outrage

水军.definition: Accounts paid to flood online platforms with specific comments, reviews, or propaganda
水军.implication: Undermines authentic public opinion; a major issue in Chinese social media; implies the 'ocean' of fake voices drowning real ones

刷屏.definition: When a single topic, meme, or event dominates all of social media at once
刷屏.implication: Could be positive virality (a hit song) or negative (a disaster); the scale implies the topic is impossible to avoid

出圈.definition: When something from a niche fandom or subculture breaks into the general public consciousness
出圈.implication: A milestone achievement for content creators or idols; implies crossing the boundary from insider culture to mass appeal

塌房.definition: When a celebrity or public figure is exposed for a scandal that destroys their image
塌房.implication: The 'house' of a fan's idol 'collapses'; implies complete loss of idol status; fans must reckon with being deceived

脱粉.definition: To stop being a fan of someone, usually after disappointment or a scandal
脱粉.implication: A deliberate act of withdrawal; often public; implies a breaking point has been reached after which admiration is no longer possible

回踩.definition: After breaking up or falling out, publicly saying negative things about the other party
回踩.implication: Implies pettiness and inability to move on gracefully; viewers often judge the person doing it more harshly

拉踩.definition: Promoting one person or thing by deliberately putting down a rival
拉踩.implication: A toxic fan behavior; instead of praising your favorite, you drag the competition; seen as bad faith and divisive

你品，你细品.definition: Telling someone to slow down and really think about what was just said or done
你品，你细品.implication: Used to hint that something has a hidden meaning or irony the listener may have missed; invites the audience to draw their own conclusions

真有你的.definition: An expression of disbelief or exasperation at someone's audacious action
真有你的.implication: Can be admiration or reproach depending on tone; often sarcastic — praising someone for doing something they shouldn't have

我哭死.en: I'm crying / this is too much
我哭死.definition: An exaggerated emotional reaction expressing being overwhelmed — by cuteness, absurdity, or good news
我哭死.implication: Hyperbolic internet expression; rarely means actual crying; signals strong emotional resonance, especially delight or secondhand embarrassment

离谱.definition: Far beyond what is acceptable, reasonable, or predictable
离谱.implication: One of the most versatile internet complaint words; the gap between expectation and reality is so wide it's almost funny

无语.definition: Left with nothing to say due to shock, disbelief, or exasperation
无语.implication: The situation is so absurd or disappointing that words fail; a mild form of passive disdain

服了.definition: Conceding defeat or expressing stunned disbelief at someone's actions
服了.implication: Ambiguous tone: can be genuine admiration ('you're incredible') or sarcasm ('I can't believe you did that'); context determines which

我谢谢你.definition: Sarcastic 'thank you' for something useless, annoying, or counterproductive
我谢谢你.implication: The politeness of 谢谢 is weaponized to express the opposite — frustration or contempt; classic Chinese internet sarcasm

好家伙.definition: An exclamation of surprise, admiration, or disbelief at something impressive or audacious
好家伙.implication: Versatile reaction: can express genuine awe or irony; similar to 'dang' or 'wow' but with a comedic edge

芜湖.definition: An enthusiastic cheer expressing excitement or celebration
芜湖.implication: Homophone used as a battle cry or victory cheer; borrowed from the city name as a sound effect; signals hype and energy

笑死.definition: Something is so funny the speaker is metaphorically dying
笑死.implication: Hyperbolic laughter reaction; equivalent to 'lmao' or 'I'm dead'; signals genuine amusement rather than polite chuckling

裂开.definition: Feeling shattered with laughter, shock, or despair; can't hold it together anymore
裂开.implication: Dual meaning: sometimes used for extreme amusement (I'm cracking up) and sometimes for devastation (I'm falling apart); tone decides which

麻了.definition: Having reached a state of emotional or cognitive numbness from too much stimulation or disappointment
麻了.implication: Expresses overwhelming saturation — from bad news, long waits, or absurdity; a step beyond 无语; you're past caring

上价值.definition: To artificially elevate the moral or philosophical meaning of something trivial
上价值.implication: Mocks people who turn mundane choices (eating, shopping) into grand statements about identity or society; performative depth

阴阳怪气.definition: Indirect, two-faced communication that says one thing while implying hostility or mockery
阴阳怪气.implication: Common complaint about online communication; the person won't directly confront but laces every word with venom; deeply annoying

爹味.definition: An overbearing, condescending attitude where someone acts like a father lecturing a child
爹味.implication: Often used to call out men (or institutions) who give unsolicited life advice with unearned authority; Chinese equivalent of mansplaining with extra patriarchal flavor

PUA.definition: Systematic psychological manipulation that erodes self-confidence to maintain control over someone
PUA.implication: Originally pick-up artist tactics, now used broadly for any toxic relationship dynamic where one party is made to feel worthless and dependent

窒息.definition: A situation or relationship so oppressive and controlling it feels like it is cutting off air
窒息.implication: Strong emotional vocabulary; signals a toxic environment where one has no freedom or breathing room

上头.definition: When something is so good it goes straight to your head and you can't stop thinking about it
上头.implication: Used for music, shows, people, food; implies loss of control in a pleasurable way; the 'high' metaphor is intentional

下头.definition: When someone or something causes you to suddenly lose interest or respect
下头.implication: Opposite of 上头; often one specific action or statement that kills attraction or enthusiasm; used in dating and fan contexts

心动.definition: The feeling of one's heart stirring with romantic interest or excitement
心动.implication: A poetic, tender expression for the earliest stage of falling for someone; implies vulnerability and surprise

意难平.definition: A feeling of unresolved sadness or unfairness that refuses to fade — the heart cannot make peace with a certain outcome
意难平.implication: Used for storylines with unsatisfying endings, lost relationships, or missed opportunities; implies the wound remains open

破大防.definition: An intensified version of 破防; one's emotional walls are completely demolished
破大防.implication: Stronger than 破防; suggests the emotional impact was overwhelming and the person had no defense left; used for both tears and rage

打工人.definition: A self-deprecating term for an ordinary working person grinding through daily labor
打工人.implication: Solidarity expression among young workers; acknowledges the exhaustion and powerlessness of modern employment with dark humor

韭菜.definition: An unsophisticated investor or consumer who is repeatedly exploited and 'harvested' by those with more power
韭菜.implication: Leeks regrow after cutting — implying victims are harvested again and again; a cynical metaphor for retail investors, housing buyers, or naive consumers

卷王.definition: Someone who takes 内卷 to extreme levels, working insanely hard and setting an exhausting benchmark for everyone around
卷王.implication: Admired and resented simultaneously; their extreme effort raises the bar for the whole group; a kind of toxic productivity idol

社恐.definition: Short for 社交恐惧症; discomfort or anxiety in social situations
社恐.implication: Self-diagnosis culture; widely used as identity label by introverts; carries humor and solidarity among those who find socializing draining

社牛.definition: Short for 社交牛逼症; someone who is fearlessly outgoing and thrives in any social situation
社牛.implication: The opposite of 社恐; used admiringly for people who can strike up conversation anywhere and make everyone comfortable

老六.definition: Someone who wins through cunning, backstabbing, or underhanded tactics rather than fair play
老六.implication: Gaming origin; in Among Us style games, the 'old six' is the sly betrayer; now used broadly for anyone who outsmarts through deception

显眼包.definition: Someone who always stands out and draws eyes — through loud fashion, behavior, or personality
显眼包.implication: Usually affectionate; implies the person is charismatic or unapologetically themselves; can occasionally be mild criticism of attention-seeking

i人.definition: An introvert, based on MBTI personality type starting with 'I'
i人.implication: Widely used self-identification in Gen-Z Chinese culture; legitimizes needing alone time; often used humorously to excuse avoiding social events

e人.definition: An extrovert, based on MBTI personality type starting with 'E'
e人.implication: The counterpart to i人; admired for social ease; used to explain why someone thrives in group settings

搭子.definition: A companion specifically for one shared activity — a meal partner, gym partner, travel partner
搭子.implication: A new social model among young Chinese; lighter than friendship, more specific; reflects a culture of functional companionship without deep emotional commitment

牛马.definition: Working like an ox or horse — an exhausted laborer with no autonomy, grinding endlessly
牛马.implication: Darker than 打工人; implies complete dehumanization; used to describe the most brutal work conditions with bitter self-mockery

特种兵旅游.definition: Cramming as many tourist attractions as possible into the shortest possible trip, military-style
特种兵旅游.implication: A trend among students who travel during short holidays; values quantity over experience; exhausting but bragged about; subverts the idea of relaxing travel

精神内耗.definition: Consuming internal energy through overthinking, rumination, or anxiety without any productive action
精神内耗.implication: All effort goes inward and is wasted; leaves you exhausted without doing anything; resonates with anxiety culture among younger generations

信息茧房.definition: The filter bubble created by algorithms that only show content confirming existing beliefs
信息茧房.implication: Coined academically but widely used online; implies people are trapped in self-reinforcing echo chambers, unaware of how narrowed their worldview has become

数字游民.definition: Someone who works remotely online while traveling, with no fixed office or home base
数字游民.implication: A lifestyle aspiration for many young professionals; represents freedom from traditional office culture; carries both envy and skepticism

脑暴.definition: Short for 头脑风暴 (brainstorm); an open ideation session to generate ideas
脑暴.implication: Corporate buzzword for collaborative thinking; using 脑暴 rather than 头脑风暴 signals a faster, startup-culture communication style

对齐.definition: To synchronize understanding, expectations, or plans between parties
对齐.implication: Tech and startup jargon; implies different people have been working with different assumptions and need to get on the same page

拉通.definition: To connect all relevant stakeholders or departments to ensure full-chain alignment
拉通.implication: Corporate speak for cross-functional coordination; often used when a project spans multiple teams and someone needs to force alignment

抓手.definition: A concrete, tangible mechanism or approach that can be grabbed and used to drive progress
抓手.implication: Overused corporate jargon; asking 'where's the 抓手?' means 'how do we actually make this happen?'; implies strategy without execution details is worthless

赛道.definition: A specific market segment, industry vertical, or competitive domain
赛道.implication: Racing metaphor for business competition; 'entering a 赛道' means choosing a market to compete in; hot 赛道 implies intense competition

闭环.definition: A complete, self-contained process where feedback flows back to the beginning to enable continuous improvement
闭环.implication: Business process jargon; 'forming a 闭环' means ensuring no steps are missing and outcomes are tracked; implies systematic thoroughness

打法.definition: The specific tactical approach or method used to compete in a market or solve a problem
打法.implication: Military/sports framing of business decisions; choosing a 打法 implies you've analyzed the terrain and picked the optimal attack angle

沉淀.definition: To build up knowledge, assets, relationships, or data over time through sustained effort
沉淀.implication: Like sediment settling at the bottom of water; implies slow but permanent value accumulation; used to justify long-term investment over quick wins

复盘.definition: A structured review of a completed project or decision to extract lessons learned
复盘.implication: From Go (围棋) — replaying a game to understand mistakes; now standard corporate ritual; implies continuous learning culture

整活.en: do something wild / pull a stunt
整活.definition: To do something entertaining, outrageous, or creative for laughs or attention
整活.implication: Internet culture term for comedic or absurdist content creation; 'he's at it again' energy; can be genuine creativity or chaotic behavior

整花活.definition: To do something unusually creative, elaborate, or showy
整花活.implication: Similar to 整活 but with more flair and skill implied; 花活 means flashy moves; used admiringly for impressive creative work

拿捏.en: nail it / have it dialed in
拿捏.definition: To have something perfectly under control — execution, style, or understanding is flawless
拿捏.implication: Can describe mastery ('she nailed that look') or manipulation ('he has her wrapped around his finger'); context distinguishes admiration from warning

心态崩了.definition: One's composure and emotional equilibrium have completely broken down
心态崩了.implication: Often used humorously after a string of bad luck; the exaggeration normalizes emotional struggle; implies the situation has become too much to bear with grace

天花板.definition: The highest possible standard in a category; the peak or pinnacle that defines the limit
天花板.implication: Used to crown someone as the best in their field: 'she is the beauty ceiling'; implies no one else comes close

刺客.definition: A product that looks ordinary but has a shockingly high price tag revealed only at checkout
刺客.implication: The 'assassin' stabbing your wallet; originated from expensive supermarket items; now used for any unexpectedly costly purchase

雪糕刺客.definition: An ice cream bar with a premium price disguised in an ordinary-looking freezer, revealed only at the register
雪糕刺客.implication: The original and most famous 刺客; spawned a whole category of 'price assassin' discourse; symbolizes creeping luxury inflation in everyday goods

夺笋.definition: A euphemism for 多损 (how vicious / how rude); used when someone's action or statement is shockingly bold or rough
夺笋.implication: Homophones used to soften a blunt assessment; softer than a direct insult but still conveys 'I can't believe you just did that'

种草.definition: To recommend something so enthusiastically that it plants a desire to try or buy it in the listener
种草.implication: Social commerce vocabulary; influencers 'plant grass' in followers; implies the recommendation was convincing enough to get into someone's head

拔草.definition: To finally try or buy something that had been on your wishlist, removing the desire
拔草.implication: The completion of 种草; the grass of desire has been pulled out; often a let-down when the reality doesn't match the hype

安利.definition: To enthusiastically recommend something to others, trying to convert them into fans or users
安利.implication: Named after Amway's famous word-of-mouth sales model; implies passionate, sometimes pushy recommendation; used affectionately among friends

恰饭.definition: When a content creator promotes a product or brand in exchange for payment
恰饭.implication: Literally 'eating rice'; acknowledges that creators need income but signals potential bias; viewers assess 恰饭 content with more skepticism

摸鱼.definition: Secretly doing personal activities during work hours instead of actual work
摸鱼.implication: From the saying 'fish in muddy water'; a universal workplace behavior treated with humor; implies passive resistance to overwork culture
